newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Hungary cenbank sees end 1997 inflation 17 pct.
newsitem.headline: Hungary cenbank sees end 1997 inflation 17 pct.

text.p: Hungarian central bank governor Giorgy Suranyi said on Wednesday the country's inflation would reach around 17 percent at the end of 1997 down from 19.8 percent at the end of 1996.
"The end-year target is around 17 percent," Suranyi told reporters during an economic conference in Vienna.
He added that inflation should fall further in 1998 but declined to give a specific target.
"Probably in 1998 there will be a chance for an even faster slowdown," he said. -- Vienna Newsroom, 43-1-53112-258
